accounting.rationale: The paragraph mixes array rank/extent/size/shape definitions, zero-size and dimension permissions, a named-array declaration requirement, declaration-time rank specification, and rank constancy.

Arrays may have up to fifteen dimensions minus corank and any extent in each dimension. 8.5.8 R814 owns array-spec declaration forms, 8.5.6 owns corank/coshape declaration restrictions, and 9.5.3.3 S9.5.3.3-002 records the rank-through-fifteen subscript-order formula. Coarray/image facets and corank-dependent execution are outside this packet.

Array size is the product of extents. SIZE owns the observable definition: S16.9.194-005 facet SIZE-DIM-extent records individual extents, and S16.9.194-006 facets SIZE-no-DIM-total-elements and SIZE-zero-size-total-elements record total element counts including zero-size arrays.

An array may have zero size. Zero-extent declaration/allocation owners remain 8.5.8 and 9.7; observable inquiry facets include SHAPE-dimension-extents in S16.9.185-004 and SIZE-zero-size-total-elements in S16.9.194-006.

Shape is determined by rank and extents and represented as a rank-one array of extents. SHAPE owns the observable definition: S16.9.185-003 facet SHAPE-result-rank-one-size-source-rank records the rank-one result size, and S16.9.185-004 facets SHAPE-dimension-extents and SHAPE-scalar-rank-zero-result record extent values including scalar rank zero.
All named arrays shall be declared; declaration syntax and array-spec alternatives are owned by 8.2 and 8.5.8 rather than a new 5.4 diagnostic.

A named array's rank is specified in its declaration and, except for assumed-rank, remains constant. R814 owns declaration-time array-spec forms; RANK owns observable rank values through S16.9.171-003 facets RANK-scalar-zero, RANK-vector-one, RANK-matrix-two, and RANK-assumed-rank-effective-rank. No legal operation changes an already declared non-assumed-rank named array's rank, so no duplicate local execution plan is added.
The paragraph combines permission to apply scalar intrinsic operations to conformable objects, elemental result semantics, and execution-order latitude for pure elemental operations.
Scalar intrinsic operations may be applied to conformable objects. 10.1.5.1 owns conformability and operation-family restrictions.
Such operations produce conformable resultant arrays elementally. Clause 10 operation-evaluation catalogues own the executable array-operation plans.
Pure elemental element operations can be simultaneous or in any order. Clause 10 owns the order-insensitivity/source-use plans; no fixture may require a particular evaluation order.

Rank-one arrays can be constructed from scalars and arrays and reshaped into allowable shapes. Array constructors are owned by S7.8-001 facets rank-one-and-scalar-sequence, higher-rank-flattening, and mixed-shapes-and-empty-source. RESHAPE is owned by 16.9.175: S16.9.175-001 facet RESHAPE-SHAPE-rank-one-integer-positive-size-less-than-16 owns allowable shape restrictions and S16.9.175-003 facet RESHAPE-result-shape-is-SHAPE owns the result shape. No duplicate construction fixture is added here.
Explicit cross-reference: arrays are described further in 9.5 and associated Clause 9 catalogues.

Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; overview definitions are cross-referenced to specific owning facets in Clauses 7-19. Source accounting only.
